name: i8087
comment: Intel 8087 numeric coprocessor (1980). Phase 29.1 (groups) added the no-op FPU escape stub for BIOS detection. Phase 29.2 (this revision) declares the FPU register file: 8 stack registers ST0-ST7 stored as 64-bit slots (LLVM i64 in the state struct, bitcast to f64 at access time per the Gemini design decision — see MD/design/29-x87-fpu-plan.md §2 'use f64 not x86_fp80 for ARM64 portability'), a 16-bit tag word (2 bits per register encoding empty/valid/zero/special), a 16-bit control word (rounding/precision/exception masks), a 16-bit status word (C0-C3 condition codes + top-of-stack pointer + exception flags), and a 32-bit TOP index (only the low 3 bits matter but i32 simplifies GEP in the emitters). Phase 29.3+ data movement, arithmetic, compares, transcendentals all reference these slots via the same StatusOffset path the base CPU's FLAGS/IP/etc. use.

status.name: FPU_ST0
status.comment: Stack-relative top-of-stack register. Physically slot 0 in the flat fpu_regs[8] array; logical ST(0) is whichever slot fpu_top points at. Emitters compute physical_index = (FPU_TOP + i) & 7 then GEP into the appropriate FPU_STn slot.

status.name: FPU_TAGS
status.comment: 2 bits per ST(i): 00=Valid, 01=Zero, 10=Special (NaN/Inf/denormal), 11=Empty. FNINIT sets all to 11.

status.name: FPU_CW
status.comment: Control word. IM/DM/ZM/OM/UM/PM = exception masks (Invalid/Denormal/Zero/Overflow/Underflow/Precision). PC = precision control (00=24-bit, 10=53-bit, 11=64-bit). RC = rounding (00=nearest, 01=down, 10=up, 11=truncate). IC = infinity control (0=projective, 1=affine). FNINIT default = 0x03FF.

status.name: FPU_SW
status.comment: Status word. IE/DE/ZE/OE/UE/PE/SF = sticky exception flags. ES = exception summary. C0-C3 = condition codes (set by FCOM/FUCOM/FTST/etc.). TOP_SW = mirror of FPU_TOP. B = busy. FNSTSW AX copies this into the CPU's AX register so the JIT'd compare path stays simple.

status.name: FPU_TOP
status.comment: Top-of-stack index (0-7). Only the low 3 bits matter but stored as i32 to simplify modular-index GEP in the emitters. Phase 29.3+ ST(i) access: physical_slot = (FPU_TOP + i) & 7.
